videoTitle: Metformin for Low Milk Supply? What the Research Actually Says
videoDescription: You've tried everything to boost supply—but what if insulin resistance is blocking your milk production? The connection is real, but the solution isn't what you'd expect. Learn what one small trial revealed at mindtivate.com.
script: You've done the pumping, the fenugreek, the power pumping—but if you have PCOS, insulin resistance might be blocking your milk production. The one trial on metformin showed something surprising: most women didn't find it worth continuing, even though...
Visit mindtivate.com to find out why.
thumbnailConcept: A tired mother sits at a kitchen table in the dim light of early morning, resting her forehead in one hand in quiet defeat as she stares down at a breast pump bottle containing only a fraction of an ounce of milk. Beside her on the table are scattered lactation supplements and a breast pump, capturing a raw, relatable moment of exhaustion and worry.
